# Historical session fixture

`historical_session_v1.json` is synthetic public test data, serialized before
supersession using the unchanged old ordinary Research -> Analyst -> Author
engine at `b72defe1fa05568175a6a39a91b858a0783d6504` (the engine itself matched
`main` at `533f45df9271978e0591fb35aa8da2b1917255b2`). It contains an actual old
Analysis-bearing turn and exact source/citation snapshot. No user database or
live provider was used. Backward-read tests preserve its record verbatim while
appending a native Research/Answer follow-up.
